title: NASA Employee Incentive Flight — Julie Levri (AFRC-2026-14630-01 Julie Levri Incentive Flight)
description: Julie Levri, a systems engineer and project manager at NASA's Ames Research Center in California's Silicon Valley, takes part in an employee incentive flight in an F/A-18 aircraft at NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, on Wednesday, July 15, 2026. NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman established the ride-along program to recognize and reward workforce members for their dedication to advancing the agency's priorities.
